Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a commission on health care insurance reform.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a commission on health care insurancereform; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) A commission on health care insurancereform is established, with members as provided in this subsection. (i) The president of the senate shall appoint one member from eachof the two largest caucuses of the senate. (ii) The speaker of the house of representatives shall appoint one member from each of the two largest caucuses of the house ofrepresentatives. (iii) The president of the senate and the speaker of the house ofrepresentatives jointly shall appoint eight members representingbusiness, labor, insurance carriers, and consumers. (iv) The insurance commissioner shall serve as the chair of thetask force, and will be a nonvoting member, except in the case of a tievote. (b) The insurance commissioner shall convene the initial meeting ofthe commission on health care insurance reform. p. 1 HB 3173 (2) The commission on health care insurance reform shall review thefollowing issues: (a) The individual health care market; (b) The small group market; (c) The association health plan market; (d) Mandated benefits; (e) Rating rules; (f) Antidiscrimination provisions; and (g) Any other aspect of health insurance the commission on healthcare insurance reform deems appropriate. (3) The commission on health care insurance reform shall report itsfindings, recommendations, and legislation based upon itsrecommendations to the governor and the appropriate committees of thelegislature by December 15, 2010. (4) The senate and house of representatives shall approve or rejectthe legislation containing the commission recommendations, withoutamendment, by April 15, 2011. (5) This section expires June 30, 2011.
